title: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset and Benchmarks for Human Activity Scene Understanding and Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the semantic similarity (using BertScore) between captions of natural 'free' actions and 'instructed' actions to evaluate whether explicitly following instructions unnaturally shifts human behavior and introduces discrepancy.

Analyzing action frequencies across prior datasets and utilizing prompt-based LLM enrichment with human-in-the-loop verification to mitigate narrow lexicalization, limited contextual variety, and stereotyped co-occurrence patterns inherent in ground-truth-first data collection.
